claimChecks.claim: All testicular veins lack valves and there is no side-to-side venous communication
claimChecks.locator: Wishahi and Sofikitis original indexed abstracts
claimChecks.note: Contradictory small series show variable valves/competence and some abdominal communication; no population prevalence inferred.

claimChecks.claim: Isolated right varicocele always mandates imaging for IVC obstruction
claimChecks.note: Further assessment retained; imaging individualized to clinical context.

claimChecks.claim: Scrotal orchiectomy automatically upstages clinical stage I cancer and requires hemiscrotectomy or radiotherapy
claimChecks.note: Inguinal route retained as standard; scrotal approach avoided for local recurrence risk, without invented automatic staging/salvage consequences.

claimChecks.claim: Torsion has 100% salvage under six hours and fixed manual-detorsion instruction
claimChecks.note: Emphasized urgent exploration, variable salvage/atrophy, manual detorsion only while awaiting surgery and perinatal nuance.

claimChecks.claim: Fowler-Stephens is mandatory for high intra-abdominal testis and collateral flow guarantees survival
claimChecks.note: One staged option among others, with testicular atrophy risk.

claimChecks.claim: TRT fertility recovers routinely in 3–6 months and SERMs are established fertility-preserving optimization
claimChecks.locator: EAU male-hypogonadism fertility and off-label anti-oestrogen sections
claimChecks.note: Removed recovery promise; described individualized evaluation and limited/off-label SERM evidence.

claimChecks.claim: Twenty ejaculations or three months determines vasectomy success
claimChecks.locator: CDC permanent contraception vasectomy comments and evidence summary
claimChecks.note: PVSA laboratory clearance required, commonly 8–16 weeks; count alone unreliable, contraception continues until clearance.
